The main takeaway from our work is that
the cerebellum should be considered as a key component of the basal ganglia-thalamocortical system and that its role should be studied in the context of this system.
the cerebellum is a key component of a complex cerebello-basalganglia-thalamo- cortical system, which is involved in a variety of functions, ranging from motor learning to cognitive processes.
the cerebellum is an essential component of a complex cerebellum-basal ganglia-cortex circuitry that is crucial to the control of behavior and cognition.
